about: The payload of an event taken whole as a record of its schema: `shown` is replaced by `_event.data` in one assignment and the payload is appended whole to a list, with the enum field carried as the variant's declared name. A payload that does not fit its schema (a layout the enum does not declare, a zoom past a uint8) is refused as a whole and writes nothing — not the layout it did carry, not the list. What the replaced record decides is read back through `peek`. Expected values are derived from the document, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: the record starts at the values its <sce:set>s give
the payload replaces the record whole and is appended whole
a variant spelled with an underscore keeps the name the document wrote
the guard reads the record the payload replaced
a name the enum does not declare does not fit the schema: nothing is written, the zoom beside it included
a zoom past a uint8 does not fit either, and the layout beside it is not written
a payload after a refused one is taken as any other
the month it came back to is no agenda
